subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio preflight history mode for requireMention channels, and what consent, retention, cost, and visibility limits must it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but silently processing unmentioned speech changes privacy, retention, provider-cost, and configuration semantics beyond a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Define a scoped Discord policy
options.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention and cost bounds, schema/docs, and requireMention history tests before implementation.

options.title: Wait for a broader media-history policy
options.body: Keep this issue as product input but avoid a Discord-only knob until cross-channel media retention semantics are defined.

options.title: Decline silent transcription
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers decide unmentioned speech must never be transcribed or retained without direct invocation.

recommendation.title: Define a scoped Discord policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention and cost bounds, schema/docs, and requireMention history tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product/security policy decision and steipete is the clearest available routing candidate from the related Discord audio PR and review history.
